integrity.proof_method: Hopf Jacobi modes, congruence and nonvanishing, cyclic aliasing

scientific_limitations: Rank, not conditioning or stable inversion, is classified.
Only equal-radius Clifford circles of winding numbers (1,2) are treated.
Bounded literature comparison cannot rule out an equivalent older representation-theoretic formulation.
Finite exact checker comparisons do not certify the infinite proof.
title: Exact-degree spherical sampling on a doubly wound Clifford circle
